result.title: Scalable Robust MCTS with Anytime Deterministic Optimality Guarantees
result.summary: MDP planners often rely on nominal transition models that may differ from the true dynamics. Robust MDP planning accounts for this uncertainty through a set of admissible models, but doing so with limited online computation is challenging: the search tree grows exponentially with the horizon and each robust backup requires an additional optimization. Existing online robust methods remain limited in scale and offer at most probabilistic guarantees. We introduce, to the best of our knowledge, the first deterministic anytime guarantees for robust online MDP planning. We restrict computation to the sampled search tree while deterministically bounding the contribution of unsampled trajectories. For any fixed policy, we derive lower and upper bounds on the gap between its projected and true robust values under rectangular and non-rectangular uncertainty sets. Under rectangular uncertainty, we propagate these bounds through the robust Bellman operator to bound the optimal robust value. These bounds are computable from the current sampled tree, hold at every node, tighten as the sampled support expands, and converge to the robust values as full support is recovered. We develop CAR-MCTS, a bound-guided MCTS planner that uses these deterministic bounds to guide exploration, prune provably suboptimal branches, and terminate once the optimal root action is certified. The fixed-policy bounds also yield an anytime policy-evaluation mechanism that certifies the robust value of any policy, independent of how it was obtained. Experiments verify the deterministic bounds, their tightening under support expansion, substantial branch pruning, root-action certification, and convergence to the optimal robust policy. To our knowledge, this is the first scalable robust MCTS framework with anytime deterministic guarantees for both online planning and policy evaluation, without enumerating the full state space.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为鲁棒在线 MDP 规划提出首个确定性 anytime 保证：在采样搜索树上确定性地界定未采样轨迹的贡献，得到投影值与真实鲁棒值的上下界，并据此构建 CAR-MCTS，用界引导探索、剪枝可证次优分支并在最优根动作被认证后终止。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「界引导搜索、可证明次优剪枝、认证后终止」的搜索与验证机制，可能为 LVR 中动态计算分配与 STOP 决策提供可核查的方法线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理，需人工判断迁移可行性。
